newsitem.title: USA: Rollins says Laidlaw waiting period ends.
newsitem.headline: Rollins says Laidlaw waiting period ends.

text.p: Rollins Environmental Services Inc Wednesday said that the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act for review of its proposed acquisition of Laidlaw Inc's Laidlaw Environmental Services, has passed with no further request for information.
Under U.S. generally accepted accounting principles Laidlaw would be deemed to be the purchaser of Rollins, thereby requiring any fair-value adjustments of Laidlaw assets to be written off.

Consequently, upon closing of the proposed transaction, Rollins estimates that a charge of $200 million, or $320 million before tax, would be taken. The charge would cover the closure, reorientation or revaluation of certain incineration, service center and landfill facilities.
Cost savings and synergies available to the combined company are now estimated to be $90 million.
A special meeting of stockholders, required to approve the transaction, is expected to be held in late April.
